texts: Your account closes now and is permanently deleted after 30 days. Sign back in within 30 days and the deletion is cancelled — after that, nothing can be recovered.
I understand my history and saved places will be gone

extra.text: Your account is deleted straight away and can't be recovered. Order records we must keep by law are anonymised.
extra.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-06: deletion is immediate. PrivacyService.eraseAccount anonymises the account at once (phone -> erased:<id>), so the mock's 30-day grace sentence promised a cancellation that cannot happen.
